name: GetScriptDataStructure
description:
Returns every variable available to a script of the given dialect and type, including an example value
and whether the variable is actually populated for that type.

Auto-completion lists the variables that exist; this lists the ones that will actually hold a value. For the Cookbook
dialect the type is a financial event type, so use this to learn what a recipe *can* read, and PreviewAccountingRecipe
to see what a specific event *did* book.

All values are fabricated: this service reads no customer data.

A list of dialects and their available types can be retrieved by calling GetScriptDialects.
auth_description: Requires a user of type `Employee` or `Api` with functionality `Scripts:View`

headers.name: EVA-User-Agent
headers.description: The user agent that is making these calls. Don't make this specific per device/browser but per application. This should be of the form: `MyFirstUserAgent/1.0.0`

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnitID
headers.description: The ID of the organization unit to run this request in.

headers.name: EVA-Requested-OrganizationUnit-Query
headers.description: The query that selects the organization unit to run this request in.

B.name: Dialect
B.description:
The dialect the script is written in, for example `Cookbook`.

This string must be between 0 (incl) and 100 (incl) characters long.

B.name: SubType
B.description:
Optional subtype. Some subtypes populate additional variables, such as the Cookbook `CashExpense` subtype carrying a TaxCode.

This string must be between 0 (incl) and 100 (incl) characters long.

B.name: Type
B.description:
The type within the dialect, as returned by GetScriptDialects. For Cookbook this is a financial event type such as `Sales`.

This string must be between 0 (incl) and 100 (incl) characters long.

D.name: Code
D.description: A unique ID identifying this error.

D.name: Message
D.description: A human-readable message describing the error.

D.name: RequestID
D.description: A unique ID identifying the request. Please provide this ID when contacting support.

D.name: Type
D.description: A short description of the error type.

E.name: ExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the resolved external IDs.

E.name: IsAsyncResultAvailable
E.description: This is a flag indicating whether the async request is done. If it is `null`, it is not an async service. If it is `false`, the response is not yet available. Do not process the properties in that case. It is is `true` the properties are filled with the result of the call.

E.name: UnresolvedExternalIDs
E.description: When using the `ExternalIDs` mode, this will hold the external IDs we couldn't resolve.

F.name: Children
F.description: The members of an object node. Null both for a leaf and for a node that was not expanded, which happens when the node is never populated or sits at the maximum depth. A node of unknown availability is listed structurally: its children carry no sample values and are themselves unknown.

F.name: DataType
F.description: The script type of the variable, for example `string`, `decimal`, `bool` or an enum name. Null for object nodes.

F.name: DeprecationMessage
F.description: Set when the variable is deprecated; the message states what to use instead.

F.name: IsAvailable
F.description: False when this variable is never populated for the requested type, even though it does auto-complete. Null when that could not be determined: the variable has to be awaited to read, or it failed to resolve. Treat null as `maybe`, not as `no`.

F.name: IsDynamic
F.description: True for variables addressed by an arbitrary name, such as CustomFields and product Content. Children are only listed where the available names are known.

F.name: Path
F.description: Full path as written in a script, for example `Order.Customer.IsDebtor`.

F.name: SampleValue
F.description: An example of the value this variable would hold. Null when the variable is not available for the requested type, and when its availability is unknown.

C.name: Variables
C.description: Empty when the dialect provides no sample data for the requested type.
